summary: Gogoro Inc., a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting four Share Purchase Agreements dated October 7, 2026 with Gold Sino Assets, Peng-Lin Investment, Ruen Hua Dyeing Weaving, and Yi Tai Investment, raising US$61.8 million of new equity. Gold Sino alone subscribed 10,692,681 ordinary shares for US$26,517,848.88, implying roughly US$2.48 per share across tranches. The company also appointed three new directors tied to the placements. Mechanics include private issuance with redacted terms; watch dilution, board composition shifts, and any follow-on overhang.
